verdict.rationale: The official GitHub repo states the hosted service at treg.to is the team's instance and that 'anyone can self-host' (treg-gh-3). Community comments independently describe it as open-source and report self-hosting it for development via a one-click setup on tarvis.io (treg-comm-3, treg-comm-6). missing for 10: first-party self-hosting/deployment documentation (requirements, configuration, how credentials and provider keys work on a self-hosted instance), evidence of feature parity between self-hosted and hosted, production-grade self-hosting reports beyond a single dev setup.
